name: Connecting language and vision together
gist: Building systems that understand images the way language models do, linking what they see to what they can describe and reason about.
explain: Language and vision are two sides of the same coin. When you describe a photo, you translate visual information into words. When you read a description and imagine the scene, you translate words back into mental images. Recent computer vision research asks: can machines do this bidirectional translation? Can a model look at a photo and write a caption? Can it read a text description and find matching images? Can it answer questions about images in natural language? These tasks require the model to bridge two completely different modalities — pixels and text — and reason about what connects them.

The challenge is that images and text are fundamentally different data types. Text is sequential and discrete: one word at a time. Images are spatial and continuous: billions of pixel values arranged in a grid. A model must learn to extract high-level concepts from images (what is this about?) and low-level details (what color is the car?) and then express those concepts in language. It must also understand language well enough to ground words in visual reality — knowing that 'dog' refers to furry animals with four legs, and that 'running' means motion, and that these concepts combine in specific ways (a running dog is different from a sitting dog). This requires learning aligned representations: internal representations of meaning that work for both images and text.

Papers in this subtheme use vision encoders — networks that convert images into meaning vectors — paired with language models that can decode those vectors into text or compare them to text embeddings. Some use transformers to process both images (as patches) and text (as tokens) in one model. Others treat the task as retrieval: learn embeddings so that images and text descriptions have similar coordinates in the embedding space, and matching is just finding nearest neighbors. Some add reasoning steps, asking the model to think step-by-step through a question before answering. Others use contrastive learning: train the model to make matching image-text pairs closer in embedding space and non-matching pairs farther apart. The underlying idea is always to find a shared representation where vision and language meet.

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Attention and Diversity for Adaptive Visual Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Proposes image-aware hybrid pruning achieving strong performance across benchmarks with reduced hallucination compared to diversity-only approaches.

papers.title: Bootstrapping MLLM for Weakly‑Supervised Class‑Agnostic Object Counting
papers.contribution: First MLLM-driven weakly-supervised framework for class-agnostic object counting that matches or exceeds fully-supervised methods while reducing annotation costs.

papers.title: Detective SAM: Adaptive AI-Image Forgery Localization
papers.contribution: Delivers 33.67% relative IoU gain over best baseline (36.99 IoU / 44.19 F1) with stable out-of-distribution performance and quick adaptation to new editors via AutoEditForge synthetic data pipeline.

papers.title: DiVE-k: DIFFERENTIAL VISUAL REASONING FOR FINE-GRAINED IMAGE RECOGNITION
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing approaches by 10.04% and 6.16% on Harmonic Mean metric in base-to-novel generalization on five fine-grained datasets.

papers.title: Figma2Code: Automating Multimodal Design to Code in the Wild
papers.contribution: Benchmarking ten state-of-the-art MLLMs shows proprietary models achieve superior visual fidelity but remain limited in layout responsiveness and code maintainability compared to design specifications.

papers.title: ImageDoctor: Diagnosing Text-to-Image Generation via Grounded Image Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves strong alignment with human preference and improves T2I generation quality by 10% over scalar-based reward models when used for preference tuning.

papers.title: LINK: Learning Instance-level Knowledge from Vision-Language Models for Human-Object Interaction Detection
papers.contribution: LINK achieves state-of-the-art results on SWiG-HOI, HICO-DET, and V-COCO, showing strong performance in both zero-shot and fully supervised settings with open-vocabulary capability.

papers.title: Math Blind: Failures in Diagram Understanding Undermine Reasoning in MLLMs
papers.contribution: Shows that training on structural representations of diagram primitives and relationships achieves +79% grounding improvement with transfer gains of 3-4% on reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: PoSh: Using Scene Graphs to Guide LLMs-as-a-Judge for Detailed Image Descriptions
papers.contribution: Achieves stronger correlations (+0.05 Spearman ρ) with human judgments in DOCENT than open-weight alternatives and works as a capable reward function.

papers.title: PromptHub: Enhancing Multi-Prompt Visual In-Context Learning with Locality-Aware Fusion, Concentration and Alignment
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superiority on three fundamental vision tasks with universal applicability across backbones, out-of-distribution settings, and various retrieval scenarios, establishing a reliable locality-aware paradigm for prompt fusion.

papers.title: Transductive Visual Programming: Evolving Tool Libraries from Experience for Spatial Reasoning
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art on Omni3D-Bench and demonstrates strong generalization to out-of-domain queries on 3DSRBench, SpatialSense, and VGBench.

papers.title: A Close Look at Negative Label Guided Out-of-distribution Detection in Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art OOD detection with theoretical analysis showing existing methods suffer from over-pessimism and proving Rényi divergence alleviates the problem.

papers.title: ActiveScope: Actively Seeking and Correcting Perception for MLLMs
papers.contribution: ActiveScope outperforms existing training-free methods, achieving 96.34% accuracy on V* Bench through active search and self-correction.

papers.title: AnyMod-LLVE: Low-Light Video Enhancement with Modality-Agnostic Inference
papers.contribution: A unified framework supporting flexible modality-agnostic inference that handles arbitrary combinations of available modalities with superior LLVE performance under modality absence.

papers.title: Artemis: Structured Visual Reasoning for Perception Policy Learning
papers.contribution: Unified architecture for diverse perceptual tasks without task-specific designs, generalizing to counting and geometric perception tasks when trained on grounding and detection samples in natural images.

papers.title: BVS: Bayesian Visual Search with Multimodal Large Language Model for Fine-grained Perception
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms baselines with superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off and provides sub-linear regret bounds.

papers.title: Beyond Unidirectional Bias: Reciprocal Perspective Calibration in Scene Graph Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance on standard benchmarks while significantly enhancing capability to understand inverse relations, verified by a new inverse consistency evaluation protocol.

papers.title: Breaking Dual Bottlenecks: Evolving Unified Multimodal Models into Self-Adaptive Interleaved Visual Reasoners
papers.contribution: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines on X2I, achieving superior generation fidelity among simple-to-complex instructions

papers.title: Bridging the Perceptual Gap: Residual-Enhanced Downscaling and Manifold-Aware Perception Alignment Adaptation for NR-IQA
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on benchmark datasets by recovering perceptual signals submerged in semantic-dense representations.

papers.title: Chain-of-Glimpse: Search-Guided Progressive Object-Grounded Reasoning for Video Understanding
papers.contribution: Consistently improves performance across general and grounded video reasoning benchmarks with strong robustness and generalization.

papers.title: CoCoEdit: Content-Consistent Image Editing via Region Regularized Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: CoCoEdit achieves superior editing quality and significantly better content consistency (measured by PSNR/SSIM and human ratings) compared to state-of-the-art models.

papers.title: Culture in Action: Evaluating Text-to-Image Models through Social Activities
papers.contribution: Proposes four metrics measuring cultural alignment, hallucination, exaggerated elements, and diversity, revealing systematic disparities favoring global north and enabling cultural faithfulness measurement.

papers.title: Decomposition of Concept-Level Rules in Visual Scenes
papers.contribution: CRD outperforms baselines on abstract reasoning benchmark and real-world image captions while improving interpretability by explicitly revealing underlying concepts and compositional rules.

papers.title: Doppler Prompting for Stable mmWave-based Human Pose Estimation
papers.contribution: Consistently improves pose accuracy and temporal stability across single- and multi-person settings by controlled Doppler prompting.

papers.title: Event-T2M: Event-level Conditioning for Complex Text-to-Motion Synthesis
papers.contribution: Matches state-of-the-art on standard tests while outperforming on multi-event cases, validated by human studies showing superior order and naturalness preservation.

papers.title: Explainable Forensics of Manipulated Segments in Untrimmed Long Videos
papers.contribution: TASLE benchmark comprises 12,472 untrimmed videos with manipulation patterns and rich annotations; MSLoc validates the importance of segment-level explainable forensics.

papers.title: FLARE: Fully Integration of Vision-Language Representations for Deep Cross-Modal Understanding
papers.contribution: Unlike existing approaches that rely on single MLP projectors for modality alignment and defer cross-modal interaction to LLM decoding, FLARE achieves deep, dynamic integration throughout the pipeline

papers.title: Flatness Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: FGA achieves substantial improvements on domain generalization and cross-dataset benchmarks while reducing computation overhead compared to existing TTA methods.

papers.title: Forensic Prompting with Dual-Action Policy Optimization for Vision-Language Forgery Detection and Localization
papers.contribution: Demonstrates favorable detection and localization performance on multiple datasets covering manual manipulations, diffusion content, face forgeries, and text-enabled settings.

papers.title: GameVerse: Can Vision-Language Models Learn from Video-based Reflection?
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that VLMs benefit from video-based reflection; combining failure trajectories and expert tutorials achieves training-free RL-like improvements.

papers.title: Grounding-IQA: Grounding Multimodal Language Model for Image Quality Assessment
papers.contribution: Constructs GIQA-160K dataset via automated annotation and develops GIQA-Bench benchmark, demonstrating that fine-grained grounding enables more detailed quality assessment.

papers.title: HiTeA: Hierarchical Temporal Alignment for Training-Free Long-Video Temporal Grounding
papers.contribution: Substantially outperforms training-free methods (44.94% R@0.1 on TACoS, 12.4% absolute gain) and achieves competitive performance against supervised baselines on long-video benchmarks.

papers.title: Human3R: Everyone Everywhere All at Once
papers.contribution: Achieves superior or competitive performance in global human motion, mesh recovery, video depth, and pose estimation with a single unified model at real-time speed (15 FPS) on 8GB memory.

papers.title: Imagine How To Change: Explicit Procedure Modeling for Change Captioning
papers.contribution: Experiments on three datasets demonstrate ProCap's effectiveness in generating descriptions that explicitly describe differences while capturing temporal dynamics.

papers.title: Immuno-VLM: Immunizing Large Vision-Language Models via Generative Semantic Antibodies for Open-World Trustworthiness
papers.contribution: Large Vision-Language Models have achieved unprecedented success in zero-shot recognition by aligning visual features with broad semantic concepts

papers.title: ImpQuant: Fine-Grained Importance-Aware Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Across multiple LVLM backbones and diverse multimodal benchmarks, our approach consistently improves accuracy at low bitwidth and reduces quantization-induced object hallucinations compared to state-of-the-art PTQ baselines

papers.title: Latent Visual Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves 71.67% on MMVP compared to 66.67% with Qwen2.5-VL, substantially improving fine-grained visual understanding through latent visual reasoning.

papers.title: Neutral-Reference Prompting for Vision–Language Models
papers.contribution: NeRP substantially improves accuracy on unseen classes without parameter modification across 15 few-shot and cross-domain benchmarks.

papers.title: OvisOCR: End-to-End Document Parsing via Aligning Specialized Perception with General Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves top-tier performance on OmniDocBench across all aspects, demonstrating that compact E2E models can surpass specialized and general methods while eliminating error propagation.

papers.title: PGT: Procedurally Generated Tasks for improving visual grounding in MLLMs
papers.contribution: Instruction tuning achieves up to +20% on What's Up and +13.3% on CV-Bench-2D, with fine-tuning state-of-the-art MLLMs yielding up to +5.5% and +8.3% improvements.

papers.title: PPLLaVA: Varied Video Sequence Understanding With Prompt Guidance
papers.contribution: To address this, we propose a novel pooling strategy that simultaneously achieves token compression and instruction-aware visual feature aggregation

papers.title: Perception-Aware Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves 4.4%-17.5% overall improvements on multimodal benchmarks, with 8.0%-19.1% on vision-heavy tasks and 30.5% reduction in perception errors.

papers.title: PhotoAgent: Exploratory Visual Aesthetic Planning with Large Vision Models
papers.contribution: PhotoAgent significantly outperforms existing methods in instruction faithfulness and visual quality across diverse editing scenarios.

papers.title: PixelCraft: A Multi-Agent system for High-Fidelity Visual Reasoning on Structured Images
papers.contribution: Dynamic three-stage workflow with image memory enables flexible reasoning, significantly improving visual reasoning on chart and geometry benchmarks.

papers.title: Play to Generalize: Learning to Reason Through Game Play
papers.contribution: The RL-trained model outperforms specialist models on MathVista and MMMU benchmarks without seeing worked solutions or diagrams, while preserving performance on general visual benchmarks.

papers.title: Pose-RFT: Aligning MLLMs for 3D Pose Generation via Hybrid Action Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: Pose-RFT significantly improves performance over existing pose-specific MLLMs on multiple benchmarks for image-to-pose and text-to-pose generation.

papers.title: Probabilistic Salient Object Ranking
papers.contribution: Demonstrates strong performance in salient object ranking; constructs 15,000-sample ProbSOR dataset supporting probabilistic ranking training and evaluation.

papers.title: PromptPilot: Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Prompt Optimization for Segment Anything
papers.contribution: Improves segmentation performance and generalization without parameter updates through game-theoretic point prompt optimization.

papers.title: Respecting Modality Gap in Post-hoc Out-of-distribution Detection with Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art out-of-distribution detection across various setups by learning visual prototypes from test data with theoretical convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Rethinking Radiology Report Generation: From Narrative Flow to Topic-Guided Findings
papers.contribution: Sets new state-of-art on MIMIC-CXR improving RadGraph F1 from 29.4 to 44.0 and CheXpert F1-14 from 39.5 to 71.5.

papers.title: Revisit Visual Prompt Tuning: The Expressiveness of Prompt Experts
papers.contribution: VAPT surpasses fully fine-tuned baselines by 7.34% on VTAB-1K and 1.04% on FGVC while requiring fewer additional parameters; theoretical analysis indicates optimal sample efficiency.

papers.title: RewardMap: Tackling Sparse Rewards in Fine-grained Visual Reasoning via Multi-Stage Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves average improvement of 3.47% across six benchmarks spanning spatial and fine-grained visual reasoning through consistent component gains.

papers.title: Self-Prompting Diffusion Transformer for Open-Vocabulary Scene Text Edit via In-Context Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves open-vocabulary and style-consistent text editing across various languages with state-of-the-art text accuracy and style consistency.

papers.title: SesaHand: Enhancing 3D Hand Reconstruction via Controllable Generation with Semantic and Structural Alignment
papers.contribution: Outperforms prior work in generation performance and improves 3D hand reconstruction with the generated hand images.

papers.title: Solving Spatial-Spectral Fusion with Latent Spectral Operators
papers.contribution:
This formulation naturally supports multi-frequency modeling, with a capacity-stability trade-off governed by the number of basis functions.

papers.title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: LLaVA-1.5 retains 95.6% performance despite pruning 88.9% of visual tokens, achieving exceptional efficiency-accuracy balance while remaining training-free and plug-and-play.

papers.title: SphericalDreamer: Generating Navigable Immersive 3D Worlds with Panorama Fusion
papers.contribution: Produces highly detailed, fully immersive 3D environments while substantially improving scale and navigability compared to prior approaches.

papers.title: Taming I2V models for Image HOI Editing: A Cognitive Benchmark and Agentic Self-Correcting Framework
papers.contribution: SCPE achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art editing models on HOI-Edit by exploiting I2V models' temporal capabilities and providing interpretable failure diagnostics via video replay.

papers.title: The Abstraction Gap in Vision-Language Causal Reasoning
papers.contribution: CAGE benchmark reveals 7 of 8 VLMs exhibit large abstraction gaps despite high text scores, showing causal reasoning and fluency are dissociable.

papers.title: Threading Keyframe with Narratives: MLLMs as Strong Long Video Comprehenders
papers.contribution: Experimental results on multiple long-video benchmarks demonstrate that Nar-KFC significantly improves the performance of popular MLLMs.

papers.title: Towards Faithful Reasoning in Remote Sensing: A Perceptually-Grounded GeoSpatial Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: RSThinker outputs verifiable analytical traces and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models across comprehensive remote sensing tasks.

papers.title: Towards Fine-Grained Robustness: Attention-Guided Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing test-time adaptation on both adversarial and clean data.

papers.title: VidLaDA: Bidirectional Diffusion Large Language Models for Efficient Video Understanding
papers.contribution: Rivals state-of-the-art autoregressive baselines while outperforming diffusion baselines, with MARS-Cache delivering over 12× speedup without accuracy loss.

papers.title: Vision Language Models are Biased
papers.contribution: Shows VLMs score 17.05% on counting tasks; background removal improves to 21.09%; reasoning accuracy initially rises to 40% then declines with overthinking.

papers.title: Visual Prompt-Agnostic Evolution
papers.contribution: PAE accelerates convergence by 1.41× on average and yields 1-3% gains on 25 datasets across multiple downstream tasks.

papers.title: WOW-Seg: A Word-free Open World Segmentation Model
papers.contribution: On 7,662-class Region Recognition Dataset achieves 89.7 semantic similarity and 82.4 semantic IoU with one-eighth parameter count of previous SOTA.

papers.title: Zero-shot Active Mapping via Fused 360-BEV Representations and Vision–Language Models
papers.contribution: Without task-specific training, improves coverage and AUC by 13.25% and 14.00% over strongest baseline while enabling language-conditioned interaction.

papers.title: [CLS] is Not Enough: Multi-Label Recognition via Patch-Level Inference and Adaptive Aggregation
papers.contribution: Achieves strong improvements with minimal computation exceeding 6% mAP gain on NUS-WIDE benchmark over baselines, fully training-free requiring no gradient updates.

papers.title: iVGR: Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning for MLLMs with Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms baselines on fine-grained benchmarks while maintaining flexibility for tool-assisted inference.
